body:
Assess official Repo2RLEnv `pr_runtime` across ten catalogued repositories’ merged-PR history, using the pinned upstream core and only its built-in model calls. **Closed after the bounded experiment and failure diagnosis; proposed recovery changes remain untested.**

**Results:** 83 exports, 74 positive tracked-test control pairs and 59 clean oracle commands. Biology contributes 66/51; medical imaging contributes 8/8. Of 23,285 inventoried PRs, 1,961 entered, 100 were omitted by upstream discovery and 21,224 remain backlog. Exports are not automatically validated tasks, and a clean selected command does not mean the entire repository suite passed. This is not an exhaustive suitability census.

**Our setup limits:** native containers had 1.5 CPUs and independent controls 1 CPU; generation/control windows and the new-batch reserve left unfinished work. Broad historical coverage and diverse C/C++/Perl/shell/scientific repositories exercise environment and test-runner assumptions. CPU limits may contribute to timeouts, but no controlled comparison establishes that cause; the authors’ exact execution setup was not established.

**Observed pipeline limits:** OpenMS hit the upstream 60-second checkout timeout; MMseqs2 exhausted the configured bootstrap allowance. SAMtools exposes test-recognition gaps; LAMMPS retained invalid protocol tails in shell commands; MACS lost compiled extensions during checkout cleanup; MNE had broad test selection and color-sensitive parsing. Four repositories encountered argument-size errors consistent with upstream script transport. Longer timeouts alone would not address all these mechanisms. Fourteen Matchms/OHIF controls never started; 15 positive-but-unclean pairs retained the same untracked failures as their base controls.

**Conclusion:** the pipeline produces useful candidates in some repositories, but reliable automated scaling needs controlled timeout/resource comparisons, resumable work queues, and targeted transport, environment-lifecycle and runner improvements. No proposed repair or diagnostic rerun was applied; production readiness and solver performance remain unestablished.

**Cost and retention:** $6.113565 OpenRouter for history / $12.088851 including September, below the $100 issue ceiling. All original jobs are terminal and owned compute is cleaned up. Nine full original public archives are verified; Matchms has curated public evidence plus untouched protected local originals, so public-only replay is incomplete. No task/image dataset release is claimed.

[All-ten diagnosis and proposed comparisons](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/af4b8656/experiments/28-catalogued-fields/history-wide/failure-diagnosis.md) · [Results](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/fed8da42/experiments/28-catalogued-fields/history-wide/cohort-report.md) · [Accounting](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/fed8da42/experiments/28-catalogued-fields/history-wide/accounting/all-ten.json). Detailed logs and historical conclusions remain in comments.
